D/ IMP NERVA CAES AVG PM TRP COS III PP ; R/ LIBERTAS PVBLICA

Silver coin. Denarius of Nerva (96-98), mint of Rome, RIC vol. 2 no. 19, issue of AD 97. Obverse description: bust laureate right, long neck and Roman nose. Obverse inscription: IMP NERVA CAES AVG PM TRP COS III PP. Reverse description: Libertas standing left with vertical sceptre holding cap. Reverse inscription: LIBERTAS PVBLICA. Diameter: 18.2mm, Weight: 2.87gms, die axis: 6
